svg.text: ATX 24-pin plug (from your flex ATX power supply) - which wires to use
Purple = +5VSB (powers the Pico) Black = ground Green = PS_ON (Option B, or jumpered to black for Option A)
A. CONTACT side (looking into the holes, latch on top)
B. WIRE side (back of the plug, latch on top) - the mirror image of A
Pin layout per the ATX12V spec (contact side, latch up: top row 13-24, bottom 1-12). All-black cable? Count positions from the latch.
